content.stem: 反洗钱审计独立性的一个关键因素在于审计员应当:

options.A: 从未在AML/CFT部门的以往职位上工作过.
options.B: 不参与该组织反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规人员的相关工作.
options.C: 在审计开始前已由董事会审查过
options.D: 接受过充分的反洗钱培训,能够进行独立审查.

content.stem_en: A key factor in the independence of an AML audit is that the auditor should:

options_en.A: Have never worked in previous assignments within the AML/CFT department
options_en.B: Have no involvement with the organization's AML/CFT compliance staff
options_en.C: Have been screened by the board of directors before the audit starts
options_en.D: Be sufficiently trained in AML to be able to provide an independent review
